config.architecture: expanded-data small U-Net with per-pixel LayerNorm
config.evaluation: leave one of 13 linked groups out; same 15000 RF reference pixels per frame
config.inference: overlapping 256-pixel tiles, stride192, probability blending before argmax
config.interpretation: exploratory cross-validation on previously inspected labels; not independent final-checkpoint accuracy

limitations: Agreement with human reference annotations, not physical sediment ground truth.
Only labelled valid pixels evaluated; unlabelled regions remain unverified.
Same sampled 15000 pixels per frame as RF; probability blending reproduced at those pixels without generating complete rasters.
Previously inspected development scenes; exploratory cross-validation, not untouched external validation.
One seed, fixed final-epoch checkpoint, no tuning or checkpoint selection.
These fold models assess the training recipe; they do not directly establish accuracy of the separate all-data checkpoint.
